sonnet.detail: A question that names the price of the commodity itself as the cause of a change in quantity demanded (Q4) tests the law of demand (demand.law) and the movement-along-the-curve concept named in demand.determinants' own covers line at the same time. The covers text for demand.determinants already distinguishes quantity demanded from demand, but does not say which subtopic wins when the question is exactly about what causes quantity demanded to change, since that is also the law of demand itself.

opus.detail: Holds birth and death rates, migration, under, optimum and over-population, and population policy. Took 4 of 80 questions (Q5, Q9, Q71, Q80) plus a possible fifth (Q55), while census and theories took one each. Split into growth and migration, and population size (under, optimum, over) with policy.

The MR = MC profit-maximising rule is general to every market structure but has no home; Q13 and Q67 land by which market is named. Name it in markets.profit-shutdown or add a rule saying the market named in the stem wins.

Challenges facing commercial banks are sent to financial.types (development banks, esusu, insurers) rather than financial.deposit-banks (commercial banks). Q34 only lands there because of an explicit counterintuitive rule; a user reading names and not covers lines will place it in deposit-banks.
Interest charged on bank loans (Q69, risk of the loan) sits between factors.rewards (interest theory) and financial.deposit-banks (bank lending). Neither covers line names loan pricing.

Price mechanism questions need three covers lines (systems.types, systems.economic-problems, price.market-system) to settle. Q46, Q50 and Q52 were placed, but which system suits the price mechanism against how a system uses it is a thin line that two readers will split on.

Questions that ask the elasticity type of a class of good (Q17, essentials are fairly inelastic) have type-shaped options (demand.elasticity) but test a determinant (demand.elasticity-uses). Add a rule for this pattern.

Current-affairs recall about Nigerian institutions (NEPA successor count Q53, BOI headquarters Q66) is scattered by one-off rules across subtopics whose concepts the question does not test. Covers lines are accumulating per-question exceptions; a single stated rule (institution facts go to the subtopic that owns the institution) would scale better.
Prime cost (Q6 option) and overhead cost are standard cost terms that no covers line names.
